Easy Baked Brie Recipe with Jam (Crowd Favorite Appetizer!)

By Mish- The Buttery Fairytale

Meet the appetizer of THE season, this baked brie recipe with jam! We top our brie cheese wheel with jam, nuts, honey and thyme and bake it to warm gooey perfection. The result is rich, velvety soft, gooey warm cheese mixed with sweet jam and honey with a nutty crunch from the walnuts. It’s the perfect mix of sweet and savory. This classy dish is wonderful during the holidays and is a huge crowd pleaser at parties. It uses only 5 ingredients, is super easy to put together and is ready in about 15 minutes too!

WHY YOU WILL LOVE THIS RECIPE

Meet this baked brie recipe with jam, one of the best holiday appetizers EVER ✨!

Okay so imagine this… We cover the top of our brie wheel with a few dollops of delicious sweet fruit jam, some chopped nuts, a drizzle of honey and just a little fresh thyme. We then bake everything to warm bubbly cheesy perfection.

As the cheese melts, all those ingredients mix together giving us the most delicious appetizer ever… ❤

That melted cheese works so well with the sweetness of the jam and honey. Golden brown toasted nuts add nutty flavors and a really nice crunch while fresh thyme adds a whole touch of deep herbiness.

The texture and flavor of this dish is incredible. Soft melty cheesy brie mixed with crunchy nuts and syrupy jam… SO.GOOD. I also usually use my favorite crackers or toast some baguette slices (or make some crostini) to scoop up that melty cheese and oh my goodness… It’s a whole other world of flavor.

All those sweet and savory flavors and crispy and soft textures will make you (and your guests) SO happy.

Go ahead and try this baked brie and jam recipe right away. It’s the perfect party appetizer, just go ahead and add it to your cheese board or charcuterie board and watch everyone fall in love!

Oh and hey, here are a few more reasons why you’ll love this delicious recipe-

We make this brie appetizer without any puff pastry to make brie the star of the show and make prep even easier.

  • The best part about this recipe is how simple it is to put togeteher and make (it takes almost zero effort) but it looks and tastes like you spent lots of time and effort making it. This is one the most impressive appetizers ever!
  • This easy baked brie is ready pretty quick too which once again makes it great for those holiday parties! It’s the absolute best during that time of year when you need to get stuff ready quick without too much effort. This recipe will be ready real quick and will stay out of your way while you’re busy with other dishes.
  • This baked creamy cheese recipe is also a pretty classy and impressive dish to serve to your guests at a party ✨. It looks like an impressive small wheel of cheese topped with so much goodness! Plus it’s SO delicious too and the ease of making it just makes it even more awesome!
  • You can customize and personalize this baked brie appetizer as you like. It’s a really versatile recipe and you can choose your own toppings. I’ve used sweet fig jam but you can use any fruit spread you like such as apricot jam, strawberry jam, blackberry jam, raspberry jam, raspberry preserves or cranberry sauce. Use your favorite jam! You can use fresh rosemary or any fresh herbs you prefer instead of thyme too. You can also use any nuts of your choice instead of walnuts such as pecans, almonds…!

INGREDIENTS & SUBSTITUTIONS FOR THIS BAKED BRIE RECIPE WITH JAM

For exact ingredient measurements, please scroll down to the Recipe Card.

This baked brie with jam recipe is one of the best holiday appetizers (especially during the busy holiday season). You can make it any time of year too!

We aren’t making brie en croute here so there’s no puff pastry sheet, crescent roll dough, egg wash, canape cutter or extra steps needed.

The best part is how impressive it looks as well. Serve it on your cheese board or charcuterie board along with some apple slices or fresh fruit of your choice, baguette slices (or drizzle some olive oil on them and bake them to make some crostini) and/or your favorite crackers, delish!

This is one of those easy recipes that has quite a short ingredient list (just a handful of ingredients). You probably have these ingredients at home already and if you don’t, you can find them at your local grocery store without a problem!

To make this baked brie recipe with jam, we need:

  • Brie cheese- Brie cheese is a delicious cheese made with cow’s milk. It can be a goat cheese as well if it’s made with goat milk. This is a deliciously melty cheese when heated through. It’s a soft cheese that works well with almost every ingredient out there. Its texture is incredible. I don’t suggest waiting until it comes to room temperature, just bake it from the fridge ❤. We use a whole brie wheel here to make this delicious appetizer look gorgeous too. I also suggest letting the brie rind stay so all that oozy goodness doesn’t completely flow out while baking. You can also use Camembert if you can’t find brie cheese.
  • Jam- We spread some sweet jam on top of the brie. The sweetness of the jam works so well with our creamy melted cheese. I usually make my baked brie with fig jam. I love sweet fig jam here but you can use any sweet or tart jam, jelly, sauce or preserves you want. When making this brie appetizer, you can use strawberry jam, raspberry jam, cranberry sauce, apricot jam, raspberry preserves, blackberry jam or a mixed fruit spread. Use any fruit jam you like. You can use your favorite jam! You can also use pepper jelly for a sweet and spicy kick. This is a very versatile recipe.
  • Walnuts- Chopped nuts work incredibly with our creamy brie cheese. They add the most amazing nutty flavors and such a nice crunch. They toast in the oven as our brie bakes turning a gorgeous golden brown and adding even more flavor ✨! I love using walnuts here but you can use nuts of your choice when making this easy baked brie such as pecans, pistachios, hazelnut, almonds or any nuts you like!
  • Honey- We add a drizzle of honey when making this easy holiday appetizer. Honey works SO well with brie and I love adding some here. This is an optional ingredient but it adds a delicious flavor here. You can use maple syrup instead of honey as well. Maple syrup works pretty well too.
  • Fresh thyme- We garnish our baked brie recipe with some fresh thyme. You can use fresh rosemary or any fresh herbs of your choice. Fresh thyme adds a beautiful herbiness to this rich cheese and rounds everything together. It balances out all the flavors and I love that. This is an optional ingredient but it adds a lovely flavor.
  • Salt- I add just a pinch of salt here. It balances out the sweetness from the honey and jam and enhances the flavors of everything too. I LOVE it. This is an optional ingredient but I really suggest adding it here.

This is the best baked brie recipe ever. It’s one of the easiest appetizers! It’s delicious and ready pretty quick without much effort as well. It’s also super impressive and your guests will love it ⭐.

HOW TO MAKE THIS BAKED BRIE RECIPE WITH JAM [Step-by-Step Instructions with Photos]

Please keep in mind that I go into lots of detail in all my recipes so you get to know all the super important tips and tricks when it comes to making a particular recipe. I always want you to make the BEST of whatever you’re cooking ❤.

Ready to cook?

Activate this button to prevent your screen from going dark

STEP 1: GET THINGS READY

So let’s learn how to prepare brie! This is an easy and delicious appetizer. There’s not much effort needed at all and you don’t need any special equipment to make it either 💃🏻. We don’t have a really long ingredient list too!

Heat oven to 350 F or 177 C.

Now take a small cookie sheet, baking sheet, small baking dish, small cast iron skillet or even brie baker and line it with parchment paper. I usually use a small shallow baking dish that’s just a little bigger than my brie wheel, this makes it easy to serve!

I also like using parchment paper here to keep things neat.

Now carefully unwrap your brie cheese and place it in the baking dish or over the small baking sheet. I don’t suggest waiting until your cheese comes to room temperature, you can use it fresh out of the fridge.

Also, no need to get the top rind out. Leave the top rind as is. Our brie rind is very important here because it’ll hold everything in while our cheese bakes. The brie rind is also edible.

Now take a sharp knife.

And using the sharp knife, draw a criss-cross pattern on top of the rind. Don’t go more than 1/2 an inch deep when drawing the criss-cross pattern on top of the rind.

STEP 2: ADD TOPPINGS TO YOUR BRIE CHEESE

Now on top of the wheel of brie, spoon jam. You can use any tart or sweet jam, jelly or sauce you prefer here such as strawberry jam, raspberry jam, cranberry sauce… Whatever is your favorite jam.

I usually use fig jam here and I love how it works with brie cheese.

When you spoon jam on top of the brie, make sure you don’t go too much in the corner. Leave about 1/2 inch of gap from the sides of the wheel or else the jam may overflow and burn while it bakes.

Now sprinkle your chopped walnuts (or whatever nuts you prefer) over the top of the jam evenly.

And then drizzle the honey…

Sprinkle the fresh thyme (or any fresh herbs you like) and salt on top of the cheese.

STEP 3: BAKE YOUR BRIE 💃🏻!

Pop your small baking dish, cookie sheet, baking sheet or cast iron skillet into the oven and bake at 350 F or 177 C for about 15 to 20 minutes. Start checking on your brie cheese from the 12th minute mark to be on the safer side.

We need to bake our brie cheese until the cheese melts and gets deliciously gooey on the inside. You may see a bit of melted cheese very slightly oozing our from the top and sides of the brie wheel as it bakes. This means it’s ready.

You can also use the back of a spoon and very gently press the sides or top of the cheese. If it’s soft to the touch (and feels all gooey), you’ll know your creamy brie cheese is ready. Please do this gently and don’t break your cheese.

We don’t want things being completely melted and in a puddle here so please keep that in mind. Our cheese wheel needs to still stay intact.

The nuts on top will also turn golden brown as your cheese wheel bakes.

Get your baked soft cheese out of the oven.

Now if you’ve used a cookie sheet or baking sheet, very carefully transfer your brie to a serving dish with the help of a spatula if you want. You can also just pick the parchment paper and place it on the serving platter.

You can drizzle some more honey on top of your baked cheese to add more flavor and give it a gorgeous look as well.

And enjoy your dish 😍! Go ahead and add it to a charcuterie board or cheese board and serve it along with baguette slices, crackers, fresh fruit (such as apple slices, grapes…) and whatever you prefer.

Now dig into your melty cheese… Enjoy that earthy soft creamy gooey cheese and all those flavors from the sweetness of the jam and honey, nuttiness from the nuts and rich earthy herby flavor from the fresh thyme.

Delicious. And you did it all yourself ❤.

Go enjoy your cheese now, bon appetit ⭐!

EASY Baked Brie Recipe with Jam (Crowd Favorite)

Ingredients
  

To make this baked brie recipe with jam, we need:

  • 1 Eight oz wheel or 227 gms brie cheese (cold from the fridge)
  • ¼ cup or 4 tbsp fig jam (you can use a jam of your choice as well)
  • ¼ cup or 4 tbsp or 30 gms walnuts chopped (can use pistachios, pecans, hazelnut, almonds or any nut of your choice as well)
  • 2 tsp honey (optional but SO good here)
  • 1 tsp fresh thyme or ¼ tsp dry thyme (can use rosemary too or any fresh herbs of your choice, this is optional)
  • ⅛ tsp or just a pinch of salt

Notes ✍🏼

If you want to know more ideas about how to serve or what to serve with this recipe, check the Serving Suggestions section.
TIPS:
  • This is a super versatile recipe. I’ve given a combination of ingredients I prefer here but you can use jam, nuts and fresh herbs of your choice too. Go ahead and experiment! Check out the Variations Section for more ideas.
  • Don’t get rid of the brie rind when making this baked brie appetizer. It’s edible (very yum too) and holds all that melted cheese in as the brie bakes in the oven and gets soft and gooey on the inside. It gives our baked brie structure.
  • We want to bake this easy holiday appetizer until it’s gooey, soft and melty but it should not collapse out of the rind and become soupy and thin. Be careful you don’t overbake here.
  • This recipe is best enjoyed fresh out of the oven. It will be warm, gooey and delicious. It will start solidifying as it cools and reaches room temperature.
  • But hey, as your cheese starts reaching room temperature and solidifying a bit, you can pop it in the microwave for about less than a minute so it melts again!
  • You can also make this baked brie in advance. Place your brie cheese wheel on a parchment paper lined baking dish or in an airtight container. Add all the toppings, wrap the top of the dish with plastic wrap and store in the fridge. It’ll stay good for about a day or two. Then bake for 15 to 20 minutes until it’s gooey on the inside when you want to have it!
  • When it comes to storage of leftovers, wait until your brie cheese reaches room temperature. Then transfer it to an airtight container and store it in the fridge. It’ll be good for about 3 to 4 days.
  • To reheat your easy baked brie, just pop it in the microwave and heat it until it’s nice and gooey on the inside. This may take about a minute or even less. You can also place your cheese in a baking dish or baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake it in the oven to reheat it at 350 F or 177 C until it’s heated through.

HOW DO I KNOW WHEN THIS BAKED BRIE RECIPE WITH JAM IS DONE BAKING?

This is a pretty easy recipe so don’t worry. It’s not like baking a cake but of course, you do need to keep a check on your wheel of cheese while it bakes in the oven.

The ideal consistency here for us is our brie being soft, gooey and melty on the inside while not completely collapsing and becoming soupy.

You’ll know your brie is done in the following ways-

  • As it bakes, you’ll start to see some melted cheese peeping through the top rind of your brie.
  • You can take a spoon and gently press the back of the spoon over the top and sides of your brie. If it’s wobbly and jiggly, it’s done!

And well that’s all! Your brie cheese will usually be ready in 15 to 20 minutes but if it it’s not, just continue baking it and check on it every couple of minutes until it’s nice and gooey on the inside.

TIPS TO MAKE THE BEST BAKED BRIE RECIPE WITH JAM EVERY SINGLE TIME

This baked brie and jam recipe is something special.

It’s such an easy appetizer recipe. You just need to put everything together which takes less than 2 minutes and then just bake!

As the brie bakes in the oven it becomes melty and delicious. It mixes with the jam and all our other toppings making things incredible…!

This particular recipe also does not use puff pastry. We take away the effort of wrapping puff pastry around our cheese and using egg wash which is awesome because it makes things even simpler.

Here are a few tips to keep in mind though to make the whole process super easy every single time-

  • Don’t get rid of the brie rind when making this baked brie appetizer. It’s edible and holds all that melted cheese in as the brie bakes in the oven and gets soft and gooey on the inside. The rind is pretty yum too.
  • We want to bake our easy holiday appetizer until it’s gooey, soft and melty but it should not collapse out of the rind and become soupy and thin. Be careful you don’t overbake here.
  • You’ll know your brie cheese is done if you gently press its top and sides with a spoon and it feels wobbly inside. The nuts will also be toasted and golden brown on top! You will also see some melty cheese peeping through the cuts in the rind.
  • This particular recipe is best enjoyed fresh out of the oven. It will be nice warm gooey and delicious. It will start solidifying as it cools and reaches room temperature.
  • The best part about this delicious appetizer though? As it starts reaching room temperature and solidifying a bit, you can pop it in the microwave for about less than a minute so it melts again. This will you some melty brie once more!
  • Use your favorite jam when making this easy baked brie and jam recipe. You can also personalize this recipe as you like, check out the Variations Section for more ideas!
  • You can also make this baked brie with jam recipe in advance with minimal effort. It’s the perfect dish to prep in advance. Just go ahead and place your brie cheese wheel on a parchment paper lined baking dish or in an airtight container. Add all the toppings, wrap the top of the dish with plastic wrap and store in the fridge. It’ll stay good for about a day or two. Then go ahead and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until gooey when you want to have it!
  • This is one of those easy recipes that stores really well! When it comes to storage of leftovers, wait until your brie cheese reaches room temperature and transfer everything to an airtight container. Then store it in the fridge. It’ll be good for about 3 to 4 days.
  • To reheat your easy baked brie, just pop it in the microwave and heat it until it’s nice and gooey on the inside. This may take about a minute or even less. You can also place your cheese in a baking dish or baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake it in the oven to reheat it at 350 F or 177 C until it’s heated through.

This is the perfect dish. It’s one of the easiest appetizers ever. Just scoop all that gooey cheesiness with some toasted baguette slices and… omg it’s just so good ✨.

RECIPE & DIET VARIATIONS YOU CAN TRY

Go ahead and serve it on your charcuterie board or cheese board and serve it along with baguette slices, your favorite crackers, fresh fruit (I really like apple slices and pomegranate here!). Literally everything works well with this rich cheese. You don’t even need any special equipment to make it.

This is one of the best baked brie cheese recipes and there’s so much you can do with it too. There are just so many variations you can try. Here are a few ideas-

  • Since my recipe here is using fig jam, you can add some dried fig on top of the brie before baking. It’ll make things look even prettier and will add a yum flavor too!
  • The sweetness of the jam works so well with our creamy melted cheese. This is a baked brie with fig jam recipe and that’s how I love making it but you can use any sweet or tart jam, jelly, sauce or preserves you like. You can make baked brie with raspberry jam, strawberry jam, apple butter, cranberry sauce, apricot jam, raspberry preserves, blackberry jam or a mixed fruit spread. Use your favorite jam! You can also use pepper jelly for a sweet and spicy kick. You can also use fruit jam according to the season.
  • I love adding walnuts on top of the jam as a garnish when making this delicious appetizer. Those toasted golden brown nuts are everything and that crunchy texture with soft melty brie and sweet jam… SO.GOOD. You can use different nuts of your choice too such as almonds, pecans, hazelnut or whatever you prefer.
  • I love adding some fresh thyme as a garnish when making this baked brie recipe with jam. You can use any fresh herbs of your choice. Fresh rosemary is a great option too!
  • I love adding a drizzle of honey over my brie wheel before baking it. You can use maple syrup or even hot honey for some spice instead!
  • My favorite when making this easy baked brie is some fig jam, walnuts, honey and fresh thyme but there are so many different combinations you can try here from the options I’ve given above! Go ahead and experiment according to your preference ❤.
  • This is the perfect dish because you can just experiment so much and it will almost always taste amazing. Go ahead and add some chili spice to your wheel of brie cheese! You can add some red chili pepper flakes. You can also work with other ingredients such as orange or lemon zest… maybe a pinch of warm spices. Some people drizzle balsamic vinegar as well. You can try balsamic vinegar here too!
  • You can add dried fruit of your choice when making this brie appetizer too such as raisins, dates, dried cranberries or cherries.
  • You can also wrap your brie in a puff pastry sheet or phyllo dough before baking! Make sure you brush some egg wash on top before popping it into the oven.
  • Brie cheese is a delicious soft cheese made with cow’s milk. It can be a goat cheese as well if it’s made with goat milk. You can also use Camembert to make this easy appetizer recipe if you can’t find brie cheese.
  • You can also make this baked brie and jam with two (or more) separate wheels of brie cheese. Add different toppings to each wheel and bake. This is especially fun when you’re serving this dish at a party so your guests can try different toppings with this melty cheese.

This baked brie with jam recipe is one of the best holiday appetizers ever. It’s super easy to make and is incredibly versatile too, I absolutely LOVE that!

Note- If you think you have an ingredient that you feel is suitable as a substitute for a certain ingredient in this recipe, according to your dietary preference, you can use it and let us know how it works as a substitute in the comments below. I’ll then add it in as an adaptation suggestion here. This will help so many others with the same diet preference as yours.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

<strong>Do I need to remove the rind when making this baked brie recipe with jam?</strong>

No, you don’t need to get rid of the rind when making this baked brie recipe with jam.

The rind is incredibly important in this recipe. We don’t even slice off the top of the rind. That’s because the rind prevents all the cheese from flowing out and becoming a soupy mess.

The rind is is pretty delish too. We use a sharp knife and draw criss-cross patterns on top of the brie but we don’t cut the rind off.

<strong>Can you prepare this baked brie appetizer in advance?</strong>

You can make this baked brie with jam recipe in advance with minimal effort 💃🏻.

Just go ahead and place your brie cheese wheel on a parchment paper lined baking dish or in an airtight container. Add all the toppings, wrap the top of the dish with plastic wrap and store in the fridge.

It’ll stay good for about a day or two. Then go ahead and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until gooey when you want to have it!

<strong>How do you store and reheat leftovers of this baked brie and jam recipe?</strong>

When it comes to storage of leftovers, wait until your brie cheese reaches room temperature. Then transfer everything to an airtight container and store it in the fridge. It’ll be good for about 3 to 4 days.

To reheat your baked brie, just pop it in the microwave and heat it until it’s nice and gooey on the inside. This may take about a minute or even less.

You can also place your cheese in a baking dish or baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake it in the oven to reheat it at 350 F or 177 C until it’s heated through.
